reason: Two big customers cut orders last quarter, so I have to replace volume and trade fairs and referrals are not doing it fast enough. I pay nothing up front and only for meetings that happened, which is the opposite of the agency that sold me slides, so I will take the free 15 companies and, if they are real fits, start the pilot.
objection: The only proof is one logistics client, not a manufacturer like us, and I have heard 'qualified meeting' before. If they send me purchasing assistants or people with no budget I will spend my evenings arguing about the 48-hour refund instead of selling, and my team still has no time for this.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 free target companies are names I already know or obvious ones off a directory, I walk away; a case from a manufacturer or exporter our size who got real quote requests would make me commit faster.
